xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Logical awaited RabbitMQ RPC; authenticate/route role guards are abstracted at entry.
Later acceptance is gated by B selecting the appropriate incoming identity; a reverse request_received result does not force B acceptance of an A->B request.
Acceptance awaits ancillary work before replying; ordinary Conversation creation is omitted by scope.
Self, absent-target and blocked-send/accept failures terminate inside the focused refs.
